verdict.rationale: Eqvista documents each ingredient of the story. It covers ESOP management and issuing equity to employees, with vesting and built-in e-signing. Board resolutions and voting come with integrated board management tools, and 409A valuations are done in-house, with a real-time common stock value view. However, nothing shows these pieces connected as one end-to-end option-grant workflow, such as a grant routed for board approval with its strike price pulled from the 409A. Missing for 10: evidence that option grants specifically are tied to a board approval step, automatic or enforced 409A-based strike pricing on the grant, documentation of a single linked issuance workflow, and independent or hands-on corroboration.
